title: Site transport of ordered affine-space integration through compactifications
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient data of [def-pur-conventions], put $A=A_{E,n}$ with $n\geq1$, and let $S$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], without assuming $S$ separated over $k$. For every scheme $T$ used below, work in the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on its small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with comparison $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] and derived tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Choose $r\geq1$ with $\ell^rA=0$, write $L_{T,r}=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^r,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A_T$, and use the root-projection comparison $C_TL_{T,r}\cong A_T(1)$ and its tensor powers [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For a separated finite-type map $f:X\to Y$ with compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$, let $F_f^e=Rp_{e,*}j_!^e$ and $F_f^p=Rp_{p,*}j_!^p$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Use precisely $B_f=Rp_{p,*}(e_j)\circ\beta_{p,j_!}:C_YF_f^e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_f^pC_X$, where $\beta$ is the counit-mate comparison and $e_j$ the adjoint extension comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].
Let $p_d:X_d=\mathbf A^d_S\to S$, $d\geq0$, with ordered coordinate tower $X_d\xrightarrow{u_d}X_{d-1}\to\cdots\to X_0=S$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. On the etale site use the ordered affine-space trace $t_d^e$ of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]. On each pro-etale affine-line projection $u$ in every such tower let $t_u^p$ be the restriction of the supported-Kummer projective-line trace of [def-pur-supported-projective-site-arrows] along the actual open counit, i.e. the restricted affine-line counit of [def-pur-proetale-affine-line-counit] at the constant object, and suppose and that these restricted traces compare with the corresponding ordinary line traces by $t_u^p B_u=C(t_u^e)$. Define their coefficient maps by the canonical compact-support inverse projection followed by $1\otimes t_u^p$ [def-pur-finite-site-tensor-projection, def-pur-proetale-projective-coefficient, def-pur-proetale-projection-integration], and define $t_d^p:F_{p_d}^pA_{X_d}(d)[2d]\to A_S$ by the ordered composite of those coefficient maps, with the canonical compact-support compositors [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-exchange-projection]; this is the ordered pro-etale integration of [def-pur-proetale-ordered-integration] (these definition nodes index the coefficient ring as $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n'+1}$ and the exponent by $\ell^{r'+1}A=0$; take $n'=n-1$, $r'=r-1$), and $B_f$ is the comparison of [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction]. Use $t_0^p=1_{A_S}$.
Then all tower schemes, their standard projective compactifications, and their Zariski open restrictions are Noetherian. Each compactified morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the shifted rank-one inputs and their pulled-back tensor coefficients in these composites are bounded constructible with finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. The canonical compact-support comparison, on every tower prefix and every chosen projective completion, identifies the actual ordered trace:
$$t_d^p B_{p_d}=C_S(t_d^e).$$
This identity respects replacement of the coordinate-tower compactification by a proper refinement or the standard projective completion, and restriction to any Zariski open subset of $S$. The map $t_d^p$ is an isomorphism in the derived category, so $F_{p_d}^pA_{X_d}(d)[2d]\cong A_S[0]$ as derived objects; the same concentration holds on the etale site. For $d=0$ the comparison and trace are the coefficient-unit identity, including when $S$ is empty.

proof.text: Finite type over the fixed field makes S Noetherian; the distinct coefficient prime is a unit by characteristic p. Induct on Model: affine towers are Noetherian, projective spaces and arbitrary compactifications are proper over a Noetherian base, and opens of Noetherian schemes are Noetherian. Every Model scheme maps to S, so the coefficient prime remains a unit. Noetherianity implies every map between these schemes is qcqs, without separatedness of the base.

proof.text: Finite Tate powers are locally free finite rank-one sheaves by finite_etale_torsion_twist_line. Their single complexes and shifts are bounded constructible and have Tor interval [-s,-s]. The generic exact site-comparison theorems preserve constructibility and this Tor interval. Convert generic constructibility to the recorded module-sheaf predicate. The published affineTraceRight_normalForm identifies each iterated right object at the unit with the shifted finite Tate power, so the same conclusions apply to every ordered input.

source.place: Paragraphs 2--3: restricted projective-line counit and ordered coordinate-tower induction.

proof.text: Apply the existing orderedIntegration_comparison theorem in every coordinate dimension. Its canonical ordinary affineTraceCounit is precisely ordinaryTrace. This supplies ordered comparison on S and every Noetherian open base, independently of the constant-input line hypothesis. The declared theorem implements the projective-line restriction and ordered composite-counit argument.

Unfold proTrace and etaleTrace and cancel the canonical compact-support site comparison to obtain their equality. The proved compactification_change_square, the etale compactification-comparison cocycle, and naturality of inclusion identify both compactification coordinate maps. Cancellation gives invariance under any compactification change. The proved refinement_site_square identifies properTransportRefinement with this change by cancelling the boundary comparison, yielding the specified refinement equation.

source.place: Paragraphs 2--3: restricted projective-line counit and ordered coordinate-tower induction.

proof.text: Apply affineTraceTowerCounit_baseChange to the canonical ordinary P1 datum and use counit naturality at the constant-unit pullback to prove ordinaryTrace_baseChange. On S and every open S-prime substitute ordered_comparison. Apply functoriality of comparison, the ordinary base-change identity, and naturality of the canonical inverse-image comparison; the normalized unit pullback gives exactly OpenCompatibility.

source.place: Paragraphs 2--3: restricted projective-line counit and ordered coordinate-tower induction.

proof.text: The proved ordinary towerCounit_isIso applies to the normalized ordinary datum. Therefore ordinaryTrace is invertible; the ordered comparison equality makes orderedIntegration invertible, and the compactification coordinate isomorphisms make proTrace and etaleTrace invertible. The ordered comparison at zero and the defining zero ordinary counit and towerSiteComparison give the pro-etale identity; ordinary affineTraceAdjunction is the identity adjunction at zero. These statements also hold on the empty base.
